title: arnica alpina subsp. sornborgeri
intro: Arnica alpina subsp. sornborgeri, commonly known as the Alpine Arnica, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is a plant-based remedy that offers various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties, making it a popular treatment for bruises, sprains, and muscle soreness. The therapeutic actions of this plant include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and providing analgesic effects through its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Arnica alpina subsp. sornborgeri are responsible for its therapeutic actions, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits.
